description.value: A 60-site campground at Lake Cowichan on Vancouver Island, likely suited to a lakeside rest day or straightforward overnight; basic facilities and caravan-site character keep it functional rather than polished.

address.value: N Shore Rd, Youbou, BC V0R 3E1, Canada

raw_osm.description: Sites are available for reservations and on a First Come, First Served, basis. Direct access to the lake.
raw_osm.name: Pine Point Campground

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Pine Point Campground is an active BC Recreation Site operated by Silvifor Resource Consultants Ltd. with a 2026 season open for reservations. The campground page explicitly states 'No power, water, sewer, or garbage removal onsite — sites are designated as dry, rustic camping,' and the FAQ confirms pit toilets are present on site. Nearby food and services in Youbou and Lake Cowichan are enumerated on the campground's own page, and the website explicitly states no discounts are offered.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational BC Recreation Site with confirmed 2026 season, offering lakeside camping with beach access and nearby resupply — a useful stop for touring cyclists in the Cowichan Lake area.
